episodes.title: Inventory
episodes.summary: Hoping to pass the IIT entrance exams, teen Vaibhav arrives in Kota with one goal: to nab a seat at the best coaching center in the city.

episodes.title: Assembly Line
episodes.summary: Canteen food, insomnia and studying weigh on Vaibhav, but when his friends' tips don't help, Professor Jeetu offers his campus-life survival strategies.

episodes.title: Optimization
episodes.summary: Struggling with Inorganic Chemistry, Vaibhav plots to have his instructor replaced, but his problem with the subject may not be the person teaching it.

episodes.title: Shutdown
episodes.summary: Given several days off before exams begin, Vaibhav, Meena and Uday each use the revision period to pursue romantic possibilities, with mixed results.

episodes.title: Overhaul
episodes.summary: Standing at a crossroads in his academic journey, Vaibhav is torn between his heart and his mind before making a big decision about his next steps.

episodes.title: Reasoning
episodes.summary: With their new classes off to a bleak start, Vaibhav and his peers question the value of the IIT dream and seek inspiration from a trusted source.

episodes.title: Control System
episodes.summary: Struggling with Physics, Vaibhav attempts to bend the rules to attend Jeetu's classes. Meena frets that teenage hormones will get the best of him.

episodes.title: Atmospheric Pressure
episodes.summary: Jeetu searches for staff for his institute, making some reluctant choices along the way. Filled with self-doubt, Vartika evades practice tests at Aimers.

episodes.title: Repair & Maintenance
episodes.summary: When a bout of jaundice slows Vaibhav down in his studying, Jeetu insists he calls his only hope to get well quickly: his mother.

episodes.title: Packaging
episodes.summary: JEE results send Kota into celebration mode and give Vaibhav, Meena and Uday glimpses into their own futures, but the occasion comes with sad truths.
